ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with a high-to-low intensity ratio of approximately 5:95; high-intensity pixels are limited to localized white ring scars and calcified barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-grey base across all visible surfaces; discrete, high-contrast white circular ring blobs (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter) are concentrated in the lower-left quadrant of the visible fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the convergence of the lobes, estimated at approximately 40-50 degrees relative to the medial axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth serrations visible along the medial trailing edge of the left lobe; pixel amplitudes of peaks range from 10 to 30 pixels relative to the edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex curvature on the distal margins of both lobes, terminating in sharp upward sweeps at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white ring patterns (resembling barnacle attachment scars) clustered on the lower and middle regions of the left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonies (rosettes) present on the leading edges and terminal tips of both lobes; visible white circular scarring from previous parasitic or barnacle attachments on the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy density of barnacle growth on the lobe tips creating a non-linear, high-relief profile distinct from the biological edge of the fluke.
